results.releaseNotes:
New: "Ask Minis" via Siri — say "Hey Siri, Ask Minis" to jump straight into a live conversation.

New: Kimi Code sign-in support, plus full OAuth login for MCP servers (with iCloud config sync across devices).

New: Codex Fast Mode toggle for OpenAI OAuth models.

New: Live Activity (privacy mode) now shows real task progress — position, status, and run time.

New: Select any text and tap "Read Aloud" to hear it via Minis TTS. Voice correction learning now uses real conversation context, further improving correction accuracy.

New: Max output length raised from 64K to 128K tokens. In-browser downloads got a full UX overhaul with floating progress cards and a downloads panel.

Stability: Fixed several stability issues in message streaming, Live Activity restore on iPad, HealthKit data reads, and config loading after a device restart. Reduced stutter during long "thinking" streams and scrolling.

Bug fixes:
- Markdown tables keep their scroll position while streaming
- Fixed duplicate thinking bubbles on retry
- Fixed invisible scroll buttons in light mode
- Fixed navbar title staying blurred after Face ID unlock
- Session list timestamps are properly localized
- Fixed in-app browser fetch failures
- Fixed Mistral chat compatibility issue
- Backfilled translations for ~200 previously English-only strings
- Added Claude Opus 5 to the built-in model list
- Fixed occasional config or chat history issues after a device restart
- Fixed occasional unresponsiveness when checking Now Playing info or using speech synthesis
- Fixed regenerating a session title not following the latest model order
- Fixed some health metric types occasionally being skipped when reading HealthKit data
- Fixed onboarding setup steps missing translations in some languages
- Reduced app install size
results.description:
Minis — Local-First On-Device AI Agent

Minis is a local-first, on-device AI agent that goes beyond chat. All your data stays on your iPhone — nothing is uploaded to a server by default. Running locally means lower latency and stronger privacy, while the agent still takes real action: browsing the web, accessing your health data, managing your schedule, controlling your smart home, and automating complex tasks.

Local-First AI Agent
Unlike cloud-only chatbots, Minis runs directly on your device and keeps your data there. The agent executes multi-step tasks autonomously, using tools and native iOS frameworks to get things done — not just answer questions, and not just relay everything to the cloud.

Multi-Model, Your Choice
Bring your own API key. Choose from leading AI providers:
• Anthropic Claude
• OpenAI GPT
• Google Gemini
• DeepSeek
• Kimi (Moonshot AI)
• OpenRouter
• Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

Deep iOS Integration
The agent accesses Apple frameworks natively:
• HealthKit — steps, heart rate, sleep, workouts, SpO₂
• Calendar & Reminders — create events, check availability, manage tasks
• HomeKit — control lights, switches, scenes, and smart accessories
• Photos — search, organize, and export from your library
• Location & Maps — current location, directions, nearby POIs
• Vision — OCR text recognition, object detection, barcode scanning
• Speech — real-time transcription and text-to-speech
• Weather — current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts

Built-in Web Browser
Navigate pages, take screenshots, extract content, fill forms, and interact with websites — all driven by the AI agent in the background.

Skills System
Import or create custom AI skills to extend the agent's capabilities. Share skills with others or build your own for specialized workflows.

Persistent Memory
The agent remembers your preferences, project context, and recurring patterns across sessions — building a personalized assistant that improves over time, all stored locally on your device.

Siri Shortcuts
Automate AI tasks with Siri and the Shortcuts app. Send prompts with file attachments, wait for results, and chain into complex workflows — all hands-free.

Privacy by Design
Your API keys and data stay on-device. Fine-grained permission controls let you decide exactly which personal data the agent can access. No account required. No data collected.
